  "canonical_python_code": "import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares

__all__ = ['calibrate_affine_stress', 'align_reference_features', 'fit_thresholded_creep']


def calibrate_affine_stress(command: np.ndarray, measured: np.ndarray, stress_scale: float, *, archive: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray] | None = None, inlier_fraction: float = 0.001, min_span_fraction: float = 0.10) -> tuple[float, float, bool]:
    """Return positive gain, bias in stress units, and whether an archive was used.

    Call once per instrument. Normalize residuals and command spans by the
    supplied characteristic stress. Use no gain ridge: a narrow or ambiguous
    current panel borrows a slope from the same instrument, whose slope must
    be stable across batches. A majority of consistent current offsets can
    update the bias; a lone check can only make a small correction. A broad
    current consensus compatible with the archive may resolve a current tie.
    Raise when neither source supports calibration rather than assume unity.
    """
    settings = np.array([stress_scale, inlier_fraction, min_span_fraction])
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(settings) & (settings > 0)):
        raise ValueError('stress scale, inlier tolerance and minimum span must be positive')

    def clean(a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        a, b = np.asarray(a, float), np.asarray(b, float)
        if a.ndim != 1 or b.shape != a.shape:
            raise ValueError('checks must be matching vectors')
        valid = np.isfinite(a) & np.isfinite(b)
        return a[valid] / stress_scale, b[valid] / stress_scale

    def consensus(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray) -> list[tuple[float, float, float]]:
        best_count = max(3, x.size // 2 + 1)
        best = {}
        for i in range(x.size - 1):
            for j in range(i + 1, x.size):
                dx = x[j] - x[i]
                if abs(dx) <= np.sqrt(np.finfo(float).eps) * min_span_fraction:
                    continue
                g = (y[j] - y[i]) / dx
                if g <= 0:
                    continue
                mask = np.abs(y - y[i] - g * (x - x[i])) <= inlier_fraction
                count = int(mask.sum())
                if count < best_count:
                    continue
                a, b = x[mask], y[mask]
                span = np.ptp(a)
                if span < min_span_fraction:
                    continue
                da = a - a.mean()
                g = da @ (b - b.mean()) / (da @ da)
                if g <= 0:
                    continue
                if count > best_count:
                    best.clear()
                    best_count = count
                best[tuple(np.flatnonzero(mask))] = (float(g), float(b.mean() - g * a.mean()), float(span))
        return list(best.values())

    x, y = clean(command, measured)
    current = consensus(x, y)
    if x.size >= 4 and len(current) == 1:
        gain, bias, _ = current[0]
        return gain, bias * stress_scale, False
    prior = [] if archive is None else consensus(*clean(*archive))
    if len(prior) != 1:
        raise ValueError('supply a same-instrument archive with an identified positive slope')
    gain, bias, _ = prior[0]
    if x.size:
        offset = y - gain * x - bias
        center = np.median(offset)
        agree = np.abs(offset - center) <= 4 * inlier_fraction
        if agree.sum() > x.size / 2 and (x.size > 1 or abs(center) < min_span_fraction):
            bias += float(np.median(offset[agree]))
        compatible = [(g, b) for g, b, span in current
                      if span >= 4 * min_span_fraction and abs(g - gain) <= 0.01
                      and abs(b - bias) <= 10 * inlier_fraction]
        if len(compatible) == 1:
            gain, bias = compatible[0]
    return gain, bias * stress_scale, True


def align_reference_features(features: np.ndarray, reference: np.ndarray, groups: np.ndarray, strata: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Remove shared group-wise affine nuisance and impute without shrinkage.

    Reference columns need not match feature columns. Both matrices share a
    row axis and must share the group-specific offset and positive gain;
    reference coupons must have comparable baseline location and spread.
    Use the median of reference-column means and population standard
    deviations. For each missing feature, average the finite cell means
    equally over occupied group-stratum cells; use zero if no cell has data.
    Include evaluation covariates only if unlabeled transduction is allowed.
    """
    x = np.array(features, dtype=float, copy=True)
    ref = np.asarray(reference, float)
    g, s = np.asarray(groups), np.asarray(strata)
    if x.ndim != 2 or not len(x) or ref.ndim != 2 or len(ref) != len(x) or g.shape != (len(x),) or s.shape != g.shape:
        raise ValueError('features, references and labels must share the row axis')
    gi = np.unique(g, return_inverse=True)[1].ravel()
    si = np.unique(s, return_inverse=True)[1].ravel()
    for code in np.unique(gi):
        rows = gi == code
        panel = ref[rows]
        use = np.isfinite(panel).sum(axis=0) >= 2
        if not use.any():
            raise ValueError('group has no reference column with two finite observations')
        panel = panel[:, use]
        panel = np.where(np.isfinite(panel), panel, np.nan)
        center = np.median(np.nanmean(panel, axis=0))
        spread = np.median(np.nanstd(panel, axis=0, ddof=0))
        if not np.isfinite(center) or not np.isfinite(spread) or spread <= 0:
            raise ValueError('reference normalization requires a finite center and positive spread')
        x[rows] = (x[rows] - center) / spread
    cell = np.unique(np.column_stack((gi, si)), axis=0, return_inverse=True)[1].ravel()
    finite = np.isfinite(x)
    total = np.zeros(x.shape[1])
    support = np.zeros(x.shape[1], dtype=int)
    for code in np.unique(cell):
        rows = cell == code
        count = finite[rows].sum(axis=0)
        sums = np.where(finite[rows], x[rows], 0.0).sum(axis=0)
        total += np.divide(sums, count, out=np.zeros_like(total), where=count > 0)
        support += count > 0
    fill = np.divide(total, support, out=np.zeros_like(total), where=support > 0)
    return np.where(finite, x, fill)


def fit_thresholded_creep(past_stress: np.ndarray, hold_stress: np.ndarray, past_durations: np.ndarray, times: np.ndarray, features: np.ndarray, strain0: np.ndarray, strain_obs: np.ndarray, rate_obs: np.ndarray, yield_stress: float, tau_bounds: tuple[float, float], *, rank_rtol: float = 1e-6) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Fit two Prony branches plus drift and supported quadratic yield terms.

    Use calibrated piecewise-constant stress, zero memory before the supplied
    history, and shared segment durations. Time, durations and bounds share
    a unit; rates are per that unit. Features are dimensionless. Nonfinite
    observations are omitted; use NaNs for prediction-only rows. Both curve
    and rate observations are needed. A plastic term with no contribution
    anywhere is fixed to zero; a term needed only on unobserved rows raises.

    Profile the linear weights using weighted least squares without ridge.
    Use bounded log-times, blockwise median absolute residual scales and
    Cauchy IRLS with a 2.5-scale cutoff. Reject locally unidentifiable fits
    via a weighted, column-normalized Jacobian (default ratio 1e-6).
    Return ordered physical taus, hereditary weights (two compliances,
    drift intercept, feature slopes), plastic weights (hold, history),
    absolute strain curves, and initial strain rates for all supplied rows.
    """
    p, h, dt, t, x, e0, obs, rates = (np.asarray(a, float) for a in (
        past_stress, hold_stress, past_durations, times, features, strain0, strain_obs, rate_obs))
    lo, hi = tau_bounds
    s0 = yield_stress
    if not (np.isfinite([lo, hi, s0]).all() and 0 < lo < hi and s0 > 0 and 0 < rank_rtol < 1):
        raise ValueError('require positive yield stress, ordered positive tau bounds and a rank tolerance in (0, 1)')
    if p.ndim != 2 or not len(p):
        raise ValueError('stress history must be a nonempty row matrix')
    n = len(p)
    if (dt.shape != (p.shape[1],) or t.ndim != 1 or not t.size or x.ndim != 2
            or len(x) != n or obs.shape != (n, t.size)
            or any(a.shape != (n,) for a in (h, e0, rates))):
        raise ValueError('inconsistent history, feature or observation dimensions')
    if not all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (p, h, dt, t, x, e0)) or np.any(dt < 0) or np.any(t < 0):
        raise ValueError('physical inputs must be finite and times nonnegative')

    log_ref = (np.log(lo) + np.log(hi)) / 2
    time_scale = np.exp(log_ref)
    lower, upper = np.log([lo, hi]) - log_ref
    p, h, dt, t = p / s0, h / s0, dt / time_scale, t / time_scale
    remaining = np.cumsum(dt[::-1])[::-1]
    end = np.r_[remaining[1:], 0.0] if dt.size else dt
    feat = np.column_stack((np.ones(n), x))
    hold_term = np.sign(h) * np.maximum(np.abs(h) - 1, 0) ** 2
    hist_term = (np.maximum(np.abs(p) - 1, 0) ** 2 @ dt) * h
    # The rate column has the same nonzero support as the row amplitude.
    # The curve column vanishes at t=0 for either plastic term.
    y = np.column_stack((obs - e0[:, None], rates * time_scale))
    valid = np.isfinite(y)
    rate_block = np.broadcast_to(np.arange(t.size + 1) == t.size, y.shape)[valid]
    if not rate_block.any() or rate_block.all():
        raise ValueError('both curve and onset-rate observations are required')
    informative = valid[:, -1] | valid[:, :-1][:, t > 0].any(axis=1)
    active = np.array([np.any(term != 0) for term in (hold_term, hist_term)])
    observed = np.array([np.any(term[informative] != 0) for term in (hold_term, hist_term)])
    if np.any(active & ~observed):
        raise ValueError('a plastic term needed for prediction is not excited in the observations')
    columns = np.r_[np.ones(2 + feat.shape[1], dtype=bool), active]
    target = y[valid]
    if target.size < columns.sum() + 2:
        raise ValueError('insufficient observations to identify the model')
    strain_scale = max(np.median(np.abs(target[~rate_block])), np.median(np.abs(target[rate_block])))
    if strain_scale == 0:
        strain_scale = np.max(np.abs(target))
    if strain_scale == 0:
        raise ValueError('zero response does not identify relaxation times')
    target = target / strain_scale

    def design(log_tau: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        tau = np.exp(log_tau)
        memory = np.exp(-end[:, None] / tau) * -np.expm1(-dt[:, None] / tau)
        gap = h[:, None] - p @ memory
        rise = -np.expm1(-t[:, None] / tau)
        curve = np.concatenate((gap[:, None, :] * rise[None, :, :],
                                feat[:, None, :] * t[None, :, None],
                                (hold_term[:, None] * t)[..., None],
                                (hist_term[:, None] * rise[:, 0])[..., None]), axis=2)
        rate = np.column_stack((gap / tau, feat, hold_term, hist_term / tau[0]))
        return np.concatenate((curve, rate[:, None, :]), axis=1)[:, :, columns]

    weight = np.ones(target.size)

    def profile(log_tau: np.ndarray, full: bool = False) -> np.ndarray | tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        log_tau = np.sort(log_tau)
        a = design(log_tau)[valid] * weight[:, None]
        z = target * weight
        norms = np.linalg.norm(a, axis=0)
        norms = np.where(norms > 0, norms, 1.0)
        beta = np.linalg.lstsq(a / norms, z, rcond=1e-10)[0] / norms
        return (log_tau, beta, design(log_tau) @ beta) if full else a @ beta - z

    def optimize(start: np.ndarray):
        return least_squares(profile, start, bounds=(lower, upper), max_nfev=100,
                             ftol=1e-9, xtol=1e-9, gtol=1e-9)

    fractions = np.array([[0.15, 0.60], [0.30, 0.72], [0.45, 0.85]])
    pilots = [optimize(start) for start in lower + (upper - lower) * fractions]
    pilots = [fit for fit in pilots if fit.success]
    if not pilots:
        raise RuntimeError('initial profiled creep fit did not converge')
    log_tau, beta, pred = profile(min(pilots, key=lambda fit: fit.cost).x, True)
    for iteration in range(12):
        resid = pred[valid] - target
        curve_scale = max(1e-8, 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(resid[~rate_block])))
        rate_scale = max(1e-8, 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(resid[rate_block])))
        scale = np.where(rate_block, np.clip(rate_scale, curve_scale / 10, 10 * curve_scale), curve_scale)
        weight = (curve_scale / scale) / np.hypot(1, resid / (2.5 * scale))
        fit = optimize(log_tau)
        if not fit.success:
            raise RuntimeError('Cauchy reweighted creep fit did not converge')
        log_tau, beta, nxt = profile(fit.x, True)
        change = np.max(np.abs(nxt[valid] - pred[valid]))
        pred = nxt
        if iteration >= 2 and change < 1e-7 * max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(pred[valid]))):
            break

    gap = log_tau[1] - log_tau[0]
    if gap < rank_rtol:
        raise ValueError('relaxation times are not separately identifiable')
    step = min(np.cbrt(np.finfo(float).eps), gap / 4)
    a = design(log_tau)[valid]
    derivatives = []
    for axis in np.eye(2):
        plus = design(log_tau + step * axis)[valid] @ beta
        minus = design(log_tau - step * axis)[valid] @ beta
        derivatives.append((plus - minus) / (2 * step))
    jac = np.column_stack((*derivatives, a)) * weight[:, None]
    norms = np.linalg.norm(jac, axis=0)
    if np.any(norms <= np.finfo(float).eps * norms.max()):
        raise ValueError('at least one creep parameter has negligible sensitivity')
    singular = np.linalg.svd(jac / norms, compute_uv=False)
    if singular[-1] < rank_rtol * singular[0]:
        raise ValueError('creep parameters are not separately identifiable')

    coefficients = np.zeros(columns.size)
    coefficients[columns] = beta * strain_scale
    hereditary = coefficients[:-2] / np.r_[s0, s0, np.full(feat.shape[1], time_scale)]
    plastic = coefficients[-2:] / (time_scale * np.array([s0 ** 2, s0 ** 3]))
    return (np.exp(log_tau) * time_scale, hereditary, plastic,
            e0[:, None] + strain_scale * pred[:, :-1], strain_scale * pred[:, -1] / time_scale)

  "synthetic_unit_test_code": "import numpy as np


def run_self_test():
    cmd = np.array([-2., -1., 0., 1., 2.])
    checks = 1.07 * cmd + 0.14
    emi = checks.copy()
    emi[2] += 8
    spot = np.array([0.70, 0.71, 0.72])
    narrow = 1.07 * spot + 0.18
    narrow[-1] -= 5
    for k in (1., 0.01):
        g, b, used = calibrate_affine_stress(k * cmd, k * emi, k * 2.)
        assert not used
        np.testing.assert_allclose([g, b / k], [1.07, 0.14], atol=1e-12)
        g, b, used = calibrate_affine_stress(k * spot, k * narrow, k * 2., archive=(k * cmd, k * checks))
        assert used
        np.testing.assert_allclose([g, b / k], [1.07, 0.18], atol=1e-12)
    with np.testing.assert_raises(ValueError):
        calibrate_affine_stress(spot, narrow, 2.)

    # Three occupied cells; neither renumbering nor reordering creates a missing cell.
    group = np.array([0, 0, 0, 1, 1])
    stratum = np.array([0, 0, 1, 0, 0])
    panel = np.array([8., 12., 10., 18., 22.])[:, None]
    raw = np.r_[10 + np.sqrt(8 / 3) * np.array([1., 3., 8.]), 28., np.nan][:, None]
    aligned = align_reference_features(raw, panel, group, stratum)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(aligned[:, 0], [1., 3., 8., 4., 14 / 3])
    perm = np.array([3, 1, 4, 2, 0])
    g = np.where(group == 0, 0.7, 3.4)[:, None]
    b = np.where(group == 0, 7., -9.)[:, None]
    moved = align_reference_features((g * raw + b)[perm], (g * panel + b)[perm],
                                     (30 - group)[perm], (stratum + 10)[perm])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(moved, aligned[perm])

    rng = np.random.default_rng(210)
    n, split = 48, 43
    tau = np.array([0.48, 2.7])
    hereditary = np.array([0.027, 0.049, 0.0031, -0.0014, 0.0018, 0.0023, -0.0012])
    plastic = np.array([0.010, 0.021])
    dt = np.array([0.2, 0.6, 0.35, 0.8])
    t = np.r_[0., np.geomspace(0.05, 10., 26)]
    ys = 2.
    x = rng.normal(size=(n, 4))
    e0 = rng.uniform(-0.004, 0.004, n)
    past = rng.uniform(-3.5, 3.5, (n, len(dt)))
    hold = rng.uniform(-3.5, 3.5, n)
    past[-2], hold[-2] = [2., -2., 0., 1.], -2.
    past[-1], hold[-1] = [0., -3.1, 2.4, 1.], -3.2

    def synthesize(p: np.ndarray, h: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        memory = np.zeros((n, 2))
        work = np.zeros(n)
        for j, d in enumerate(dt):
            decay = np.exp(-d / tau)
            memory = decay * memory + (1 - decay) * p[:, j, None]
            work += d * np.maximum(np.abs(p[:, j]) - ys, 0) ** 2
        amp = (h[:, None] - memory) * hereditary[:2]
        amp[:, 0] += plastic[1] * work * h
        drift = hereditary[2] + x @ hereditary[3:]
        drift += plastic[0] * np.sign(h) * np.maximum(np.abs(h) - ys, 0) ** 2
        truth = e0[:, None] + amp @ (1 - np.exp(-t[:, None] / tau)).T + drift[:, None] * t
        return truth, (amp / tau).sum(axis=1) + drift

    def fit(p: np.ndarray, h: np.ndarray, e: np.ndarray, r: np.ndarray, ks: float = 1., kt: float = 1.):
        return fit_thresholded_creep(ks * p, ks * h, kt * dt, kt * t, x, e0, e, r / kt,
                                     ks * ys, (kt * 0.12, kt * 9.))

    truth, rate = synthesize(past, hold)
    obs, rates = truth.copy(), rate.copy()
    obs[[2, 12, 21, 31], [5, 8, 17, 22]] += [1., -1.5, 1.2, -1.8]
    rates[4] += 1.3
    obs[split:], rates[split:] = np.nan, np.nan
    joint = fit(past, hold, obs, rates)
    assert all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in joint)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(joint[0], tau, rtol=2e-3)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(joint[1], hereditary, rtol=2e-3, atol=1e-5)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(joint[2], plastic, rtol=2e-3)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(joint[3][split:], truth[split:], atol=1e-4)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(joint[4][split:], rate[split:], atol=1e-4)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(joint[3][:, 0], e0, atol=1e-14)

    # The dimensional axes are stress and time; there is no carrier or sensor graph.
    ks, kt = 0.01, 0.5
    scaled = fit(past, hold, obs, rates, ks, kt)
    expected = (kt * joint[0], joint[1] / np.r_[ks, ks, np.full(5, kt)],
                joint[2] / (kt * np.array([ks ** 2, ks ** 3])), joint[3], joint[4] / kt)
    for a, b in zip(scaled, expected):
        np.testing.assert_allclose(a, b, rtol=2e-5, atol=2e-8)

    below_p = np.clip(past, -ys, ys)
    below_h = np.clip(hold, -ys, ys)
    below_truth, below_rate = synthesize(below_p, below_h)
    below = fit(below_p, below_h, below_truth, below_rate)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(below[2], np.zeros(2))
    np.testing.assert_allclose(below[0], tau, rtol=2e-3)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(below[3], below_truth, atol=1e-5)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(below[4], below_rate, atol=1e-5)

    # A below-yield training set must not silently extrapolate to super-yield.
    unknown_p, unknown_h = below_p.copy(), below_h.copy()
    unknown_p[-1], unknown_h[-1] = past[-1], hold[-1]
    below_truth[split:], below_rate[split:] = np.nan, np.nan
    with np.testing.assert_raises_regex(ValueError, 'not excited'):
        fit(unknown_p, unknown_h, below_truth, below_rate)


run_self_test()
